messages.subject: Project Redwood — instruction (Aldersgate Street acquisition)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Redwood House, 14 Aldersgate Street EC1A. It's a multi-let office investment, six storeys plus a ground-floor retail unit, four tenants, passing rent c.£1.49m. Price agreed in principle at £21.75m, off-market via the seller Hartmoor Estates.

We'll be buying through a new SPV. Could you send your engagement letter and get title review under way? Howard wants this to board on 5 March.

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Project Redwood — instruction (Aldersgate Street acquisition)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Delighted — thank you for the instruction. Engagement letter attached; please sign and return, and we'll send AML requirements for the SPV directors separately. James will have day-to-day conduct, with Elena assisting on the lease review.

We'll request the title pack and replies from Pemberton Rowe today and aim to report to you in good time before the 5 March board. On a £21.75m price the SDLT will be around £1.077m — worth flagging to your tax team.

Best,
Sarah
